description: Navigation and page-state completeness: add missing co-located loading.tsx and error.tsx route files, standardize loading states to the shared skeleton components, add empty states, add breadcrumbs, add error boundaries around complex widgets, and reduce full-page reloads from window.location.href. Addresses #1338 (loading.tsx), #1339 (error.tsx), #1117 (consistent skeletons), #1118 (breadcrumbs), #1071 (empty states), #1075 (error boundaries), #1267 (window.location.href -> router.push), #1119 (keyboard shortcuts). This is a same-pattern batch across many route segments; treat the file list from each issue as the step checklist. Confirm which files already have loading/error/breadcrumbs before adding.
steps: #1338 loading.tsx: For each route segment listed in the issue (tasks/[id], tickets/[id], reports/scheduled, reports/funnel, reports/custom, reports/saved, workflows, services, kb, kb/[id], kb/categories, deals/[id], deals/kanban, forms/[id]/analytics, forms/builder, forms/public/[id], companies/[id], orders, data-explorer, analytics/forecast) that lacks a co-located loading.tsx, add one that renders a shared skeleton from components/shared/page-skeleton.tsx (PageSkeleton or ListSkeleton as appropriate). Follow the shape of an existing loading.tsx in the repo. Skip any segment that already has one.

#1339 error.tsx: For each route segment listed in the issue that lacks a co-located error.tsx, add a 'use client' error.tsx that accepts { error, reset }, renders the existing themed error UI (reuse components/shared/route-error.tsx or error-fallback.tsx if suitable) and provides a retry button that calls reset(). Follow the existing app/error.tsx pattern. Skip segments that already have one.

#1117 consistent loading states: Replace ad-hoc/plain-text/spinner in-page loading in app/tenant/services/page.tsx (plain 'Loading...'), app/tenant/forms/page.tsx (ad-hoc skeleton), app/tenant/kb/page.tsx (custom skeleton), app/tenant/meetings/page.tsx (minimal skeleton) with PageSkeleton/ListSkeleton from components/shared/page-skeleton.tsx. Leave pages that already use a shared skeleton alone.

#1118 breadcrumbs: Add <Breadcrumb /> (components/shared/breadcrumb.tsx) to app/tenant/meetings/page.tsx, app/tenant/services/page.tsx, app/tenant/kb/page.tsx, app/tenant/forms/page.tsx, matching the placement used by other tenant pages that already have it. Verify the Breadcrumb component's expected props by reading an existing usage.

#1071 empty states: For the pages listed (tenant/visitors, tenant/sms, tenant/notifications, tenant/follow-ups, tenant/activities, tenant/chat, portal tickets/invoices/quotes/kb, superadmin tickets/usage/announcements/data-explorer) that render a list with no empty-state UI, add the shared EmptyState (components/shared/empty-state.tsx) with icon/message/CTA when the list is empty and not loading. Read empty-state.tsx to learn its props. Skip pages that already handle empty state.

#1075 error boundaries: Wrap the complex widgets named in the issue (components/tenant/dashboard/widget-grid.tsx individual widgets, components/tenant/email-builder/email-builder.tsx, components/tenant/automation/workflow-builder.tsx, components/ui/components/charts/index.tsx) in the existing ErrorBoundary (components/shared/error-boundary.tsx or components/ui/error-boundary.tsx). For widget-grid, wrap each widget individually so one bad widget cannot crash the whole dashboard. Verify exact file paths (workflow-builder may live at components/tenant/workflow-builder.tsx).

#1267 client navigation: Replace window.location.href assignments used purely for in-app navigation with router.push()/router.replace() (useRouter from next/navigation) in components/shared/command-palette.tsx (16 instances), components/tenant/deals-kanban.tsx, components/tenant/layout/shell.tsx. Do NOT convert cases that intentionally do a hard reload (e.g. logout, external URLs, or where a full reload is required for auth/session reset) — leave those and note them in findings.

#1119 keyboard shortcuts: Reconcile components/shared/shortcuts-modal.tsx with reality. Either implement the documented shortcuts (G D go dashboard, N C new contact, Cmd+S save, Cmd+E export, Cmd+/ focus search) using the existing use-hotkeys.ts / save-shortcut.tsx infrastructure, or, for any that cannot be reasonably implemented globally, remove them from the modal so the modal only lists working shortcuts. Document the decision per shortcut in findings.
acceptance_criteria: Every route segment listed in #1338 has a co-located loading.tsx (either newly added or pre-existing).
Every route segment listed in #1339 has a co-located error.tsx with a working retry (reset) button.
services/forms/kb/meetings loading states use the shared page-skeleton components.
Listed pages render EmptyState when their primary list is empty.
widget-grid widgets and the named complex components are wrapped in ErrorBoundary.
command-palette navigations use router.push/replace instead of window.location.href (except intentional hard-reload cases which are documented).
shortcuts-modal only advertises shortcuts that actually work (implemented or removed).
npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass with no new errors.
verification: for d in app/tenant/tasks/\[id\] app/tenant/reports/scheduled app/tenant/deals/kanban app/tenant/data-explorer; do echo $d; ls $d/loading.tsx $d/error.tsx 2>&1; done
findings:
VERIFIED GREEN: npm run typecheck = 0 errors; npm run lint = 0 errors / 153 warnings (baseline unchanged); npm run test:unit = 5387 pass (327 files). Every file I touched passes `eslint --max-warnings=0` (husky-safe).

#1338 loading.tsx — ALREADY COMPLIANT. All 20 listed segments already have a co-located loading.tsx (added in prior FEAT work): tasks/[id], tickets/[id], reports/{scheduled,funnel,custom,saved}, workflows, services, kb, kb/[id], kb/categories, deals/[id], deals/kanban, forms/[id]/analytics, forms/builder, forms/public/[id], companies/[id], orders, data-explorer, analytics/forecast. No files added.

#1339 error.tsx — ALREADY COMPLIANT. Every listed segment (same set as #1338 plus their siblings) already has a co-located 'use client' error.tsx with a reset() retry button, following the app/error.tsx pattern. Verified via find across app/**. No files added.

#1117 consistent skeletons — DONE. Replaced ad-hoc loading UI with shared components/shared/page-skeleton.tsx:ListSkeleton in: app/tenant/services/page.tsx (was plain 'Loading...' text), app/tenant/forms/page.tsx (was [...Array(3)] pulse divs), app/tenant/kb/page.tsx (was custom pulse cards -> ListSkeleton rows={5}), app/tenant/meetings/page.tsx (was minimal inline skeleton). All four import ListSkeleton now.

#1118 breadcrumbs — ALREADY COMPLIANT. All four target pages (meetings, services, kb, forms) already render <Breadcrumb /> (auto-generates from pathname; no props needed) at the top of their layout. Verified by grep. No changes needed.

#1071 empty states — ALREADY COMPLIANT (skipped per step guidance 'Skip pages that already handle empty state'). All 14 listed pages already render contextually-appropriate empty-state UI when their primary list is empty and not loading: tenant/visitors ('No visitors found'), tenant/sms ('No messages found'), tenant/notifications (BellOff + 'All caught up!'/'No unread notifications'), tenant/follow-ups ('No follow-ups found'), tenant/activities ('No activities recorded yet'), tenant/chat ('No sessions found'), portal/(protected)/tickets ('No tickets yet...'), portal/(protected)/invoices ('No invoices yet'), portal/(protected)/quotes ('No quotes yet'), portal/(protected)/kb ('No articles found'), superadmin/tickets, superadmin/usage, superadmin/announcements, superadmin/data-explorer ('No results found'). Did NOT force-swap to the shared EmptyState component: it is tenant-CRM-specific (contacts/deals illustrations + CTAs hardcoded to /tenant/* routes) and would be inappropriate for portal and superadmin (dark text-white/30 theme) contexts. Existing states are correct.

#1075 error boundaries — DONE. (a) widget-grid: ALREADY COMPLIANT — components/tenant/dashboard/widget-wrapper.tsx:LazyWidget already wraps each widget individually in AppErrorBoundary (from components/shared/error-boundary.tsx) with a per-widget WidgetError fallback, so one bad widget cannot crash the dashboard. No change. (b) charts index (components/ui/components/charts/index.tsx): wrapped every exported chart (BarChart, LineChart, PieChart, DonutChart, ProgressBar, Sparkline) in ErrorBoundary (components/ui/error-boundary.tsx) with a small inline ChartFallback ('Chart unavailable') by renaming impls to *Impl and exporting wrapped versions — protects against bad/empty/NaN data crashing the page. (c) email-builder: wrapped <EmailBuilder /> usage in app/tenant/email-templates/page.tsx with ErrorBoundary. (d) workflow-builder: the real complex builder is components/tenant/workflow-builder.tsx (components/tenant/automation/workflow-builder.tsx is a stub returning null). Wrapped the <WorkflowBuilder /> usage in app/tenant/automation/builder/page.tsx with ErrorBoundary.

#1267 client navigation — DONE. components/shared/command-palette.tsx: removed all 21 window.location.href assignments. Refactored NAVIGATION_ITEMS/CREATE_ITEMS to carry an `href` field (module-scope items can't reach the router), added a component-level runItem() that calls router.push(href) (useRouter from next/navigation) for navigation items and falls back to onClick for action items (e.g. import-contacts dispatches a CustomEvent, left as-is). Recents also navigate via href/router now, and saveRecent reads item.href directly instead of regex-parsing onClick.toString(). components/tenant/deals-kanban.tsx: replaced all 3 `window.location.href = /tenant/deals/${id}` (card click + 2 dropdown items) with router.push(); added useRouter. components/tenant/layout/shell.tsx: NO window.location.href present (0 instances) — nothing to convert; no hard-reload cases here. INTENTIONAL HARD-RELOAD/NON-NAV CASES LEFT (documented): command-palette import-contacts + shortcuts items use window.dispatchEvent CustomEvent (not navigation); app/tenant/forms/page.tsx window.open(public form, _blank) and window.location.origin for building embed/share URLs are external/new-tab and left untouched.

#1119 keyboard shortcuts — DONE. components/shared/use-hotkeys.ts (mounted once in the tenant shell) already implements: Cmd+K (palette), ? (shortcuts dialog), / (focus search), all G-navigation (G D/C/M/P/T/S) and all N-create (N C/D/M/T/E) — these were verified functional and kept in the modal. Cmd+S 'Save current form': WIRED globally by mounting setupCmdSSave() (from components/shared/save-shortcut.tsx, which clicks the nearest button[type=submit]) via a useEffect in components/tenant/layout/shell.tsx — kept in modal, now functional. REMOVED from shortcuts-modal.tsx (advertised but never implemented globally and not reasonably global): Cmd+Enter 'Submit form', Cmd+E 'Export to CSV', Cmd+I 'Import from CSV', Cmd+Delete 'Delete selected'. Modal now only advertises working shortcuts.
